RMBS · June conditional research / 六月条件研究

Scope

June 30, 2026 conditional model using October 19 information. Select an explicit award policy to allocate common equity. The August ASR is outside this June anchor; every current price target remains unavailable. Not a historical backtest.

采用十月十九日信息的 2026 年六月三十日条件模型。明确选择奖励政策后才分配普通股权益。八月加速回购不属于六月起点；所有当前目标价保持不可用。不是历史回测。

Summary

Rambus supplies memory-interface chips, silicon IP and patent licensing. Product, royalties and contract revenue have separate fading growth paths. Bear, base and bull cases are analyst scenarios without assigned probabilities.

Rambus 提供内存接口芯片、硅知识产权和专利许可。产品、特许权使用费及合同收入具有分别递减的增长路径。熊、基准、牛情景均为分析假设，未指定概率。

Growth

The TTM June revenue anchor is $756.331m: product $377.276m, royalties $290.699m and contracts $88.356m. Annual edits retain aggregate revenue; the original segment mix is contextual, not an independently reforecast segment model. Ten rolling June years are not calendar fiscal guidance.

截至六月的滚动收入为 756.331 百万美元：产品 377.276、特许权使用费 290.699、合同 88.356。年度编辑使用合计收入；原分部组合仅为背景，并非独立重估的分部模型。十个截至六月的滚动年度不是日历财年指引。

Profitability

Margins retain economic compensation. Only an explicitly selected legacy expense runout is removed after corporate tax before allocating the corresponding legacy claim. Residual new-grant cash-equivalent cost stays in margins; it is never subtracted twice.

利润率保留经济薪酬成本。只有明确选择的旧奖励费用摊销才在公司税后加回，再分配相应旧奖励请求权。剩余新授予的现金等价薪酬仍在利润率中，不重复扣除。

Capital

Net reinvestment is the greater of growth NOPAT divided by marginal ROIC and revenue-based investment plus incremental working capital. Entered investment cannot fall below this floor; the app does not silently repair it. Noncash legacy expense reclassification does not change reinvestment.

净再投资取增长税后营业利润除以边际 ROIC 与收入投资加增量营运资本的较大者。输入投资不可低于此下限；应用不会静默修正。旧奖励非现金费用重分类不改变再投资。

Funding

June cash and securities are $824.948m. Valuation deducts the $28.182m recognized EDA claim; funding reserves all $31.435m nominal EDA payments. With zero securities haircut, the equity bridge is $711.718m and initial funding liquidity $708.465m. Legacy cash settlement is paid before each year’s FCFF. Funding shortfalls suppress conditional per-share output; no financing is invented.

六月现金及证券为 824.948 百万美元。估值扣除已确认 EDA 请求权 28.182；资金测试预留全部名义支付 31.435。证券折价为零时，权益桥接为 711.718，期初可用资金为 708.465。旧奖励现金结算先于每年自由现金流收入。资金不足时隐藏条件每股值，不虚构融资。

Wacc

WACC and all ten-year business assumptions are analyst inputs. Settlement price grows at the selected annual discount factors only to reconcile cash planning with claim allocation; it is not an expected stock return.

WACC 及全部十年经营参数为分析假设。结算价格按所选年度折现因子增长，仅使现金规划与请求权分配一致；不是预期股票收益。

Tax

The selected legacy addback removes its old modeled tax shield. No separate future corporate tax benefit is assumed. Gross employee withholding is not reduced by corporate tax.

所选旧奖励加回移除原模型税盾。不假设未来另有公司税收利益。员工代扣的现金总额不乘公司税后系数。

Terminal

Terminal investment retains both the marginal-ROIC and operating-investment floors. The ten-year horizon and June origin remain fixed. Ordinary annual values and terminal assumptions can be edited at full precision.

终值投资保留边际 ROIC 与经营投资两项下限。十年期限及六月起点固定。年度值和终值假设可按完整精度编辑。

Claims

108.461603m June common shares and 2.476181m reported nonvested units are dated facts. Choose overlap, vesting, residual net claim equivalents, settlement timing, both cash fractions and a securities haircut. Residual units are economic equivalents after proceeds, not a literal option/ESPP share count.

六月普通股 108.461603 百万股及未归属奖励 2.476181 百万单位为指定日期事实。需选择重叠、归属、剩余净请求权等价单位、结算时间、两项现金比例及证券折价。剩余单位是扣除所得款项后的经济等价物，不是实际期权或员工购股数量。

Awards

Example policies assume an 8% revenue compensation allowance and $57.625m/$57.625m/$23.05m legacy runout. This is an analyst decomposition, not a disclosed amortization schedule. Residual choices 0, 0.1m and 2.476181m are illustrations, not evidence of absence or a verified maximum. Selecting an example explicitly accepts its complete assumptions; no example is preselected.

示例政策假设收入 8% 的薪酬预留及 57.625／57.625／23.05 百万美元的旧奖励摊销。这是分析拆分，不是披露的摊销表。剩余 0、0.1、2.476181 百万单位是示例，不证明缺失或核实上限。选择示例即明确采用全部假设；无预选。

History

FY2016–2025 history retains all v2 revisions and field-level provenance. Revenue recognition and divestiture gains limit comparability. CFO minus cash capex is descriptive cash flow, not unlevered FCFF; it excludes financing-classified EDA payments. Missing observations remain null.

2016–2025 财年历史保留全部 v2 修订及字段级来源。收入确认和剥离收益限制可比性。经营现金流减现金资本开支是描述性现金流，并非无杠杆 FCFF，且不含融资分类 EDA 支付。缺失观察值保持空值。

Guidance

The record preserves 69 metric-period guidance/actual observations with original ranges, issue dates, subsequent release dates and public source links. Comparisons are against prior issuer guidance, not analyst consensus. Management forecasts and accounting bases are not interchangeable.

记录保留 69 个指标期间的指引／实际观察值，含原区间、发布日期、后续实际发布日期及公开来源链接。比较对象是公司先前指引，不是分析师共识。管理层预测与不同会计口径不可互换。

Uncertainty

No calibrated scenario probabilities or market-price fitting. Manual simulation varies the edited business path and checks both investment floors; the award policy stays fixed. Only operating EV is simulated; June policy-based common value is deterministic only. The current ASR-adjusted capital and exact granular awards remain unresolved.

没有校准情景概率或拟合市场价。手动模拟改变已编辑经营路径并检查两项投资下限；奖励政策保持固定。仅模拟经营企业价值；六月政策普通股值仅为确定性计算。当前回购后资本和精细奖励盘点仍未解决。
